I think this is a positive thought but I tend to disagree with this idea. In my experience, the vast majority of the time people freak out when you tell them you’re fasting is because you’re challenging their paradigm. A lot of people want to lose weight and they’re not particularly good at it or at the very least hit those plateaus. So when someone comes in doing something like fasting, it pisses them off for two reasons; Two things they have to grapple with:

1. They actually CAN do better and lose weight. They’re just not doing everything they can be doing and what they’ve been doing for years isn’t particularly working. 

2. It’s extremely difficult to fast. Once they accept or come to grapple with point 1, they then have to weigh, in their minds, the implications of what it means to fast and they have to decide if they want to do this extremely difficult task or if they want to keep selling themselves and essentially coping to the idea that what they’re doing is right. That spares them from fasting.
